# nBROWSER

> MCP server and CLI that reads live web pages and search results for an agent. It returns Markdown with the source URL and a token count, and it drives a browser session when a page needs one. Part of the NOTT family.

- It is not a general HTTP client or a proxy into a private network. It refuses private, link-local and cloud metadata addresses. It allows loopback (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`).
- CLI: `nbrowser <noun> <verb>` (`nbrowser --help`).
- MCP server: `nbrowser mcp serve` (stdio). 14 tools, all named `nbrowser_*`. Use `nbrowser_page_extract` for a known URL and `nbrowser_web_search` when you do not have the URL.
- Configuration: `NOTT_NBROWSER_CHROME_BIN` names the browser binary for live sessions. Static reads and web search need no browser. Store directory, with the credential vault: `~/.nott/state/database/`, or `NOTT_DATABASE_DIR` in tests.
- Invariants: each hop and each DNS answer goes through the network guard. An action on an old page generation is refused. The vault encrypts passwords with AES-256-GCM and sends each one only to its own origin. Cite the URL of each page read.
- Install: `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://no.tt/install.sh | sh`, or `uv sync --group dev` in a clone.
